crates_io.description: URL library for Rust, based on the WHATWG URL Standard

2.5.9.name: url

reviewed.note: Both .crate files from static.crates.io diffed file by file against 2.5.8 (checksums = Cargo.lock's = crates.io's; published by Manishearth 2026-11-20; vcs ad1c66cb). src/origin.rs: a blob: URL takes the inner URL's origin only for http/https/file, else opaque - no recursion, the fix for RUSTSEC-2026-0592 (test_origin_nested_blob, 10 000 nested blob:). Besides, WHATWG alignment in src/parser.rs: the path percent-encode set gains ^ and ` (QUERY moved up), a file URL's host is no longer dropped before a drive letter, a backslash after a port ends it only for special schemes, last_slash_can_be_removed searches the path only (quadratic parse fixed); src/lib.rs doc and html_root_url; form_urlencoded 1.2.3 required. Tests and WPT data updated. No build.rs, no proc macro, no new dependency, the same one unsafe block as 2.5.8, no new network or process code; the medium findings (127.0.0.1 and 1.35.33.49 URLs in tests and doc examples) and the YARA network rules are the same as 2.5.8's. axross-amp does not call Url::origin(): url reaches it only through eframe -> egui-winit -> webbrowser (Url::parse, Url::from_file_path); ureq 3 does not use url.

2.5.9.young_release: The fix for RUSTSEC-2026-0592 (stack overflow in Url::origin() on nested blob: URLs), 1.5 days old; the whole diff against the reviewed 2.5.8 read.
